content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Online car listings and dealer software with advertising; it sells marketing to dealers rather than auctioning salvage vehicles."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Freight trucking and intermodal transportation for shippers; no vehicle auctions, remarketing or salvage business."},{"label":"C3","good":true,"reason":"Wholesale and online used-vehicle auctions with yards, fees from sellers and buyers, closely matching Copart's remarketing model."},{"label":"C4","good":true,"reason":"Online and live auctions with yard-based asset disposition for insurers and sellers, matching Copart's model, though for industrial equipment."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Railcar manufacturing, leasing and highway guardrail production; a manufacturer and lessor, not an auction or remarketing service."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Traffic enforcement cameras and toll processing for governments; regulated enforcement business with no vehicle auctions or salvage sales."}]}
